headline: Approved NOI 028-3155 49 Crafts Road and NOI 028-3157 37 Horton Street & 26 Wonson Street; continued several wetland permit applications, including Tommy's Island shed proposal
summary: The Conservation Commission reviewed and continued multiple Notice of Intent applications for properties along Wingaersheek Road, Rocky Neck Avenue, Washington Street, and other sites. The Commission approved a new home at 49 Crafts Road and a dock/stairway project at 37 Horton Street & 26 Wonson Street, approved several Certificates of Compliance, ratified an Emergency Certificate and an Enforcement Order, and discussed ongoing violations at several properties.
